research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Coursera is researching systems and methods for building educational courses by using a description of an educational course to prompt a large language model to generate modular course outlines with detailed module descriptions. It is also developing a virtual browser cloud workspace for an online hands on learning platform that delivers guided projects via containerized environments, and secure computer implemented execution and evaluation of programming assignments for online courses, covering course authoring, interactive practice, and assessment.

product.description: Self-paced online courses covering business, AI, data science, computer science, IT, healthcare, languages, arts, and other academic and professional subjects.

product.name: Professional Certificates
product.description: Job-oriented online programs from companies and universities that teach practical skills for roles such as data analyst, project manager, UX designer, IT specialist, and cybersecurity analyst.

product.name: Coursera for Business
product.description: An enterprise learning platform for delivering online courses and Professional Certificates to employees, with workforce training, learning analytics, integrations, and skills benchmarking.

product.name: Online Degrees
product.description: Online bachelor’s and master’s degree programs provided through Coursera’s university partners in fields including business, computer science, data, and related disciplines.

product.name: Coursera Plus
product.description: A subscription service providing unlimited access to thousands of Coursera courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates during the subscription period.

product.name: Specializations
product.description: Multi-course learning programs that develop practical or academic expertise in a defined subject through a sequence of related online courses.
